title: Verify notification sent on resource creation
gherkin:
Given a lifecycle event notification system
When a new resource is created
Then a creation lifecycle event notification should be sent
And the notification should contain the resource identifier
And the notification should contain the creation timestamp
rationale: Resource creation is a fundamental lifecycle event that must trigger notifications to inform stakeholders of new resources entering the system.
generationSummary: Lifecycle event notification coverage ensures that all relevant lifecycle events trigger appropriate notifications to inform stakeholders of state changes and transitions in the system.

title: Verify all lifecycle events are covered by notifications
gherkin:
Given a lifecycle event notification system
When a resource undergoes any lifecycle event
Then a corresponding notification should be sent
And no lifecycle event should occur without a notification
And all notifications should be delivered to registered subscribers
rationale: Complete coverage of lifecycle events ensures that all state changes are communicated, preventing information gaps for stakeholders.
generationSummary: Lifecycle event notification coverage ensures that all relevant lifecycle events trigger appropriate notifications to inform stakeholders of state changes and transitions in the system.

title: Verify notification delivery to multiple subscribers
gherkin:
Given a lifecycle event notification system with multiple subscribers
When a lifecycle event occurs
Then the notification should be delivered to all registered subscribers
And each subscriber should receive the same notification content
And delivery should occur within the expected timeframe
rationale: Lifecycle event notifications must reach all interested parties to ensure comprehensive coverage and awareness of system changes.
generationSummary: Lifecycle event notification coverage ensures that all relevant lifecycle events trigger appropriate notifications to inform stakeholders of state changes and transitions in the system.

title: Verify notification contains required event metadata
gherkin:
Given a lifecycle event notification system
When a lifecycle event notification is generated
Then the notification should contain the event type
And the notification should contain the resource identifier
And the notification should contain the event timestamp
And the notification should contain the event source
rationale: Notifications must include essential metadata to enable subscribers to properly identify, track, and respond to lifecycle events.

title: Verify notification system handles concurrent lifecycle events
gherkin:
Given a lifecycle event notification system
When multiple lifecycle events occur concurrently
Then each event should generate a separate notification
And notifications should not be lost or merged
And each notification should be delivered independently
And the order of notifications should be preserved where applicable
rationale: The notification system must maintain coverage and reliability even under concurrent event conditions to ensure no lifecycle events are missed.
